cases.case_label: Founder AluY in RP1 exon 4 (Korean IRD patients)
cases.disease: RP1-related retinitis pigmentosa / inherited retinal disease
cases.mechanism_detail: The founder 328-bp AluY in the last exon (exon 4) of RP1 was found heterozygous in 6/411 Korean IRD patients, all with a second RP1 pathogenic variant in trans; it is expected to escape NMD and disrupt the last 758 amino acids. The paper highlights allele dropout causing false homozygosity of c.4196del.
cases.quote: All patients with AluY were confirmed to have RP1 pathogenic variants on the paired allele.
